reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses a CDP-connected Doubao desktop app to recognize chat and local images for text-only models, with optional local image archiving.

summaries.zh: 通过 CDP 桥接桌面豆包，为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型识别聊天图片和本地图片。
summaries.en: Uses a CDP bridge to the Doubao desktop app to provide chat and local image recognition for text-only models in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Sends chat images and prompts to the desktop Doubao application for recognition
Controls the Doubao desktop application through a CDP debugging connection
Automatically launches or restarts Doubao with a remote debugging port
Copies and archives image attachments on the local filesystem
